reviews.title: Siri doesn’t work at all
reviews.text:
“I can’t add items to bring right now”

I contacted support about this and to quote the Simpsons, “we’ve tried nothing and are all out of ideas.”  Reinstalling didn’t work.  

Super low effort support.  

Response to the response - yeah, I got exactly this response from the devs by email, and it didn’t work the second time.  Thanks for the same copy and paste.

reviews.title: Was great until it stopped working with Alexa
reviews.text: This used to be a fantastic app but ever since Alexa got upgraded earlier this year, Bring no longer works with it, unless you specifically launch it from the Alexa app. This is a complete dealbreaker as it means I can no longer simply add items when cooking. I've contacted support and they say they have no plans to fix the problem.

reviews.title: Drops items from list
reviews.text: Avoid this app. It does not share well. It drops items on list and items move up from recent purchases to current list.
